rows.name: FP8 GEMM 1024^3 (f32 in, e4m3 tensor cores, f32 out)
rows.notes: Every column quantises float32 A and B to e4m3 and returns float32; PyTorch's time includes the quantisation and B's transpose, as Y's and Triton's include theirs.
